items.text: David Fear, a senior film critic at Rolling Stone, presents the five best films from 2025. Fifth, Richard Linklater’s Nouvelle Vague explores the world of the French New Wave and serves as an exciting cinematic team-up for fans of film history. Clint Bentley’s Train Dreams follows at number four, and offers a beautifully crafted adaptation of Denis Johnson’s novella that tells an epic story from the early twentieth century. Robert Grainier, a railroad worker, lives a quiet life until he marries and has a daughter. Steven Soderbergh’s Black Bag takes the third spot. It is a spy drama where a top British intelligence agent must find a mole leaking classified software. Number two is Chloe Zhao’s Hamnet , which uses the novel by Maggie O’Farrell. The historical drama depicts the tragedy of William Shakespeare’s son and the emotional strength of his wife, Agnes. It illustrates how personal pain can lead to artistic healing and catharsis . The top film of 2025 is Paul Thomas Anderson’s latest work, One Battle After Another . It captures the complex feelings of living in modern America and suggests that the best way to handle a broken world is to focus on love. Difficult words: team-up (an occasion when two or more people or characters work together to achieve something), novella (a short book), catharsis (releasing strong emotions through art). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

David Fear works for Rolling Stone as a film critic . He shares the five best movies from 2025. Richard Linklater makes Nouvelle Vague , a movie about French film history where famous directors meet. Clint Bentley takes fourth place with Train Dreams . This movie tells an epic story from the early twentieth century. It is about a life or a railroad worker. Steven Soderbergh created the third movie, Black Bag . In this spy film, a British agent looks for a person who steals secret software. The second movie is Hamnet . It comes from a famous novel, and shows the tragedy of William Shakespeare’s son and his strong wife. It explains how art helps people overcome difficult situations in life. Paul Thomas Anderson makes the best movie, One Battle After Another . It shows life in modern America and teaches that love helps a broken world. Difficult words: film critic (a person who watches movies and tells people if they are good or bad), spy (a person who gets secret information about someone, a business, or another country), tragedy (a very sad event or situation). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

David Fear is a film critic . He names five great movies from 2025. The fifth movie is about French art and history. It is called Nouvelle Vague . The fourth movie is Train Dreams . It is a long story about a man in the early twentieth century. His life changes when he gets married and has a daughter. The third movie is a spy film called Black Bag . A British agent looks for a person who has important information. The second movie is Hamnet . It is about William Shakespeare and his family. The story is sad because their son dies. The best movie is One Battle After Another . It shows life in America today. The story is big. It says that love is important for everyone. This film helps people understand a difficult world. Difficult words: film critic (a person who watches movies and tells people if they are good or bad), married (to have a husband or wife), spy (a person who gets secret information about someone, a business, or a country). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Many people set goals for the new year, but most stop after a short time. Studies show that only a small number of people reach their resolutions . Psychotherapist Lisa Palmer explains that this often happens because people try to change actions without changing how they think. She says mindset plays a key role in success. When people believe they are capable and worthy , goals feel more possible and less stressful. Palmer advises people to start with small and realistic steps. Goals should match personal values and life purpose. She explains that motivation grows when people feel supported, sometimes with coaching or professional help. Mistakes will happen, but failure doesn’t mean the goal is lost. Pro gress comes from standing up again and learning what works better next time. She also stresses kindness toward oneself. People should accept imperfect days, focus on strengths, and try new methods instead of repeating old habits. Palmer says that positive thinking, health, happiness, and presence in daily life make long-term success easier to achieve. Difficult words: resolution (a clear decision or promise to change or do something), worthy (good enough to deserve respect, care, or success), progress (slow movement forward or improvement). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Many people make New Year’s goals, but most quit after a few weeks. An expert explains that people fail because they focus only on actions and not on thinking. She says a strong mindset helps people believe they can change and succeed . She tells people to choose small and clear goals. Goals should fit the person and feel meaningful. A coach or therapist can help you stay focused and motivated. When people make mistakes, they should not give up. They can learn and try again in a new way. Palmer also says people need to be kind to themselves. Everyone has bad days, but positive thinking helps people stay calm and keep moving forward. When people care about their health and stay happy, goals feel easier to reach. Difficult words: fail (to not reach a goal or not succeed), mindset (the way a person thinks and sees situations), succeed (to reach a goal or do something well). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Many people make New Year’s goals . But most people stop after a short time. An expert says why this happens. She says that people need to change how they think, not only what they do. When people believe in themselves, goals feel easier. She says goals must be small and simple . People can ask for help from a coach or expert. Mistakes happen, but people can try again. One bad day does not stop you from getting better. Palmer says that people must be kind to themselves. Positive thoughts help you feel strong and calm. Health, happiness, and focus on today help people reach goals step by step. Difficult words: goal (what you want to do or reach in the future), simple (not difficult), mistake (something what you do wrong). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In 2025, the world saw many positive changes. Clean energy produced more electricity than coal for the first time. Countries such as China, India, and many in Europe increased solar and wind power while coal use fell. Several European states closed their last coal plants earlier than planned. As a result, low-carbon energy reached a record share of global electricity. These changes showed that large energy systems can shift in a short time. Governments also supported people and families. Australia reduced student debt for millions of citizens without long processes. In the United States, New Mexico offered free childcare to all families, which lowered costs and created new jobs. Environmental protection also grew. A very large ocean area received protection, and new forest projects started in Africa and the Americas. These actions helped both nature and the local people. Science and health have made strong progress. New tools allowed faster tracking of climate pollution. Several animal species recovered after long protection. Doctors approved a malaria treatment for newborn babies and slowed a serious genetic illness. Cancer care became faster and easier. Overall, 2025 proved that clear decisions can improve life worldwide. Difficult words: shift (a change from one thing to another), citizen (a person who belongs to a country), species (a group of animals or plants that are the same kind). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In 2025, many good things happened around the world. Clean energy made more electricity than coal for the first time. China, India, and Europe used more energy from the sun and wind. Some European countries closed their last coal plants early. Low-carbon energy reached a new high level. These changes showed that countries can change their energy use when they choose to act. Governments helped people in simple ways. Australia cut student debt for many people. In the United States, New Mexico gave free childcare to all families. Parents saved money, and many workers found new jobs. Countries also protect nature. Large ocean and forest areas got new protection , which helped animals and local people. Health care also improved. Doctors got a malaria medicine for newborn babies. Other medical work helped people with serious illnesses and cancer. These steps made life better for many people. Difficult words: coal (a black rock people burn to make energy), student debt (money a student must pay back after studying), protection (keeping people, animals, or places safe). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In 2025, the world has good news. Clean energy makes more power than coal . Many countries use more sun and wind power. Some countries in Europe are closing coal power plants . People use cleaner energy now. This helps the Earth. There is also help for families. Australia helps students with money. New Mexico gives free childcare to all families. Parents save money. Many people get new jobs. Countries look after nature too. Big ocean and forest areas get help. Animals live in safer places. Doctors help people in new ways. Babies get malaria medicine. Doctors help people with serious illnesses. Cancer care is faster and easier. Life feels better for many people. Difficult words: coal (a black rock people burn to make energy), power plant (a place where people make energy for homes and cities), childcare (care for children when parents are at work). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Thailand and Cambodia have signed a new ceasefire agreement after weeks of deadly fighting along their border. The deal started at midday local time and orders both sides to stop military movement and stop using airspace for attacks. The war began over disputed border land and caused deaths and damage in both countries. Only Thailand used air attacks during the conflict and hit places inside Cambodia. The agreement says that after 72 hours of calm, Thailand will return 18 Cambodian soldiers it held after earlier fights. Defense ministers from both countries signed the deal at a border checkpoint after several days of talks by military officers. The agreement repeats earlier promises from July and October and should reduce tension . Past deals failed as fighting continued in December. Tens of soldiers and other people died, and many people left their homes. The deal also calls for no false information, respect for land mine rules, border talks, and cooperation against cross-border crime, such as online scams. Difficult words: ceasefire (an agreement to stop fighting), disputed (not agreed on, when two sides both say something is theirs), tension (a feeling of stress or danger between people or countries). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Thailand and Cambodia sign a ceasefire to stop weeks of fighting near their border. The deal starts at midday and tells both sides to stop moving soldiers and not use planes or air attacks. The conflict began because both countries wanted the same land near the border. Thailand used air attacks during the fighting. The deal says Thailand will send 18 Cambodian soldiers back home after three days without fighting. Officials signed the deal at the border after military leaders talked for several days. The deal also asks both sides to stop giving false news, respect rules about land mines , talk about the border, and work together to stop crime like online scams . Earlier ceasefires didn’t work, and fighting started again in December. Many people died, and many people left their homes. Each country said that the other was responsible for the fighting. Difficult words: ceasefire (an agreement to stop fighting), land mine (a bomb in the ground which explodes when you step on it), scam (a trick on someone). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Thailand and Cambodia make a deal to stop fighting at their border . The deal starts at midday. Both countries stop moving soldiers and stop using planes for fighting. The fighting starts because both countries want the same land. Thailand uses planes in the fighting. The deal says Thailand will send 18 Cambodian soldiers home after three quiet days. Leaders from both countries meet at the border. They sign the deal there. Many people die in the fighting. Many families leave their homes. Both sides say the other side starts the problem. The deal asks both sides to tell true news, stop using land mines , talk about the border, and work together to stop crime. Difficult words: border (the line between two countries), sign (to write your name to show that you agree with something), land mine (a bomb in the ground which explodes when you step on it). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Researchers from three Australian universities working on the southern Great Barrier Reef found that male snakes approached divers, coiled around their fins, and struck at camera reflections. The large olive sea snakes are especially active in the southern winter during breeding season. Divers are at risk of being bitten by the sexually aroused snakes who mistake the divers for their potential mates. The stakes are very high because the snakes have the capacity to bite humans with a deadly venom . The olive sea snake is the most common sea snake along the northern coast of Australia. Growing to lengths of over two meters, this species is well adapted to a life on coral reefs. It’s a true snake, and, like all reptiles , it breathes air. However, unlike the sea turtles, crocodiles, and other marine reptiles, which must nest on shore, the snake’s entire life occurs in the ocean. Difficult words: aroused (excited), the stakes are high (there is a lot of risk), venom (a poisonous substance which animals such as snakes or spiders inject into their prey), reptile (a cold-blooded animal like a snake, lizard, or crocodile). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Australian researchers found that the large olive snakes followed divers at the Great Barrier Reef. The snakes probably thought that the divers were other snakes. It was the snakes’ breeding season , and they became very active. They came close to the divers, curled around their fins , attacked their cameras, and made funny movements. The snakes could attack the divers at any time, which was very dangerous because the large olive snakes were venomous . The olive sea snake is the most common snake in the sea north of Australia, and it can be more than two meters long. Like other snakes, it breathes air, but it lives only in the sea. Difficult words: breeding season (the time of year during when animals are sexually active), fin (one of two thin objects which a diver puts on his feet, and it helps him swim in water), venomous (an animal or insect which bites someone, and the person or animal can die from the bite). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The large olive snakes live in the sea near Australia. The snake is more than two meters long. It is a venomous snake. Venomous means that if the snake bites someone, the person can die. Now it is the snake’s breeding season . The snakes become very active. They look for a mate . The snakes mistake divers for their mates. They follow the divers. They curl around their feet. They attack the cameras. It is very dangerous. The snakes can attack divers at any time. The large olive snake is a reptile. Reptiles are cold-blooded animals like a snake, lizard, or crocodile. These animals lay eggs on the land near the sea. The olive snake breathes air. It still spends all its life in the sea. Difficult words: breeding season (the time when an animal wants to make babies), mate (a sexual partner), mistake (to think that a person or thing is somebody or something else). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A new study surveyed hundreds of bird species in the USA and Canada and found that nearly a third of birds disappeared from most biomes since 1970. That is almost three billion birds. According to the magazine Popular Science, today’s extinction rate is estimated to be 1,000 times greater than it was before humans. Difficult words: disappear (die), biome (a large group of animals and plants, for example savanna or forest), extinction rate (the speed with which the animals are dying out). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A study surveyed hundreds of types of birds in the USA and Canada. It found out that nearly a third of birds died from most biomes since 1970. That is almost three billion birds. According to the magazine Popular Science, today’s extinction rate is around 1,000 times greater than it was before humans. Difficult words: survey (watch, study), biome (a large group of animals and plants such as the savanna or forest), extinction rate (the speed with which the animals are dying out). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Scientists study birds in the USA and Canada. From 1970 until now, 33% of all birds die. That is almost three billion birds. The birds are dying because of people. Birds die 1,000 times faster when there are people compared to when there are no people. Difficult words: until (to). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Brigitte Bardot was a very famous French film star who died at the age of 91. She became well known in the 1950s after her role in the film And God Created Woman . Her strong style and free way of acting felt new at the time. Many people saw her as a sign of change for women in films and in society. She became popular not only in France but also around the world. Although she enjoyed great success, Bardot often felt unhappy. She said fame made her feel trapped and alone. She faced many personal problems, and after many films and songs, she decided to leave the film world in the early 1970s. She then moved to Saint-Tropez and chose a quiet life away from public life. In later years, Bardot focused on helping animals. She started a group to protect them and spoke strongly about this cause . Some of her political opinions caused anger and legal trouble; however, her cultural impact and work for animals remained important. Difficult words: fame (being famous and known), trapped (not able to leave or feel free), cause (something you care about and want to help). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Brigitte Bardot was a famous French actress who died at 91. She became popular in the 1950s after a film role which surprised many people. Her look and acting style felt new and made her very well known. She became a strong cultural figure in France and other countries. But fame didn’t make her happy. She often felt sad and alone. After many films and songs, she stopped acting and left public life. She moved to Saint-Tropez to live quietly. Later, Bardot spent her time helping animals. She started an organization and spoke often about animal care. Some people disliked her ideas, but many still remember her work in film and for animals. Difficult words: cultural figure (a person many people know and talk about), fame (when many people know who you are), public (people). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Brigitte Bardot is a famous film star from France. She becomes popular after a strong film role. She is very young at this time. Many people know her face and style . She helps change how women look in films. Fame feels hard for Bardot. She feels sad and alone. After many films and songs, she leaves acting. She moves to a town near the sea and lives a quiet life. Later, Bardot helps animals. She starts a group to keep them safe. She talks about animals and their care. Many people remember her for her films and for helping animals. Difficult words: popular (when many people like someone or something), style (how someone looks or does things in front of other people), fame (when many people know who you are). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Researchers have created 3D models of spider webs to listen for spider signals. Then, they recreated the sounds with the help of computers and algorithms . The world of spiders isn’t audible to the human ear; however, artificial intelligence helps solve some of the mystery. Silk from a spider web is five times stronger than steel, and as the web gets more dense, the sound gets more complex. The frequency spectrum , the chords , or we can even say melodies, are the kind of relationships that spiders would also experience. Therefore, in a way, we can begin to feel a little bit like spiders. The discovery could lead to innovations in construction and repair, and scientists hope that one day, they could communicate with spiders. Difficult words: algorithm (a set of mathematical instructions that a computer must follow to solve a problem), audible (able to be heard), frequency spectrum (the range of vibrations within which a signal occurs), chord (a combination of notes that makes music). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Scientists studied 3D models of spider webs, and they used computers to make unusual sounds. A computer program checked the density of a web. If the density was higher, the music was more complicated. It was not usual music but a melody which scientists thought that spiders could feel. People cannot hear how spiders communicate because our ears cannot hear signals of this frequency . Scientists hope that one day, they can communicate with spiders. Spider webs are very strong, and the silk is five times stronger than steel. Scientists believe that in the future, they can use it in construction. Difficult words: density (the number of things in a place or a thing), melody (a short song), frequency (the size of the waves which a sound makes), silk (a very strong material which some insects make and people use it to make clothes). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A spider web is a net that spiders make. The net is sticky . Spiders use it for catching flies, beetles, and other animals. The net is very strong. It is from silk . Silk is five times stronger than steel . Scientists study spider webs. It is possible that they will help in building in the future. Also, scientists study other things. A computer program makes a 3D model of a net. It changes it into music. Scientists think that spiders can hear this music. It is very unusual. People cannot hear these sounds. Spiders can. Scientists hope that one day, they will understand spiders. Difficult words: sticky (when something stays on your hands when you touch it), silk (a very strong material which some animals make, and people use it to make clothes), steel (a strong metal), 3D (when something is not thin like a piece of paper, but it has a top and bottom, a front and back, and two sides). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Baku, Azerbaijan, is changing how people move to build a more livable and sustainable city. The city now designs streets and public spaces for people, not only for cars. New bus lanes, bike lanes, and shared travel areas support walking, cycling, and public transport. These changes aim to cut traffic, lower pollution, and make daily travel easier. Many residents say the new transportation system saves time and money, and improves their daily lives. Bikes and scooters help people travel short distances quickly, especially near the city center. Train and metro stations now include bike parking, which helps people move smoothly between different types of transport. Public transport remains a key part of this plan. Baku invests in electric and low-emission buses to make travel cleaner and safer. City leaders say bikes alone are not enough, so strong bus services matter. As Baku prepares to host a global urban event, its transport plan shows how cities can support a greener future. Difficult words: livable (a place that is good and comfortable to live in), host (to welcome and hold an event), urban (about a city or town). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Baku, Azerbaijan, is changing its transport system to make the city better for people. Streets now support walking, bikes, and buses more than cars. The city has new bike lanes, bus lanes, and shared travel spaces. These changes help lower traffic and make the city cleaner. Many people say they travel faster and spend less money. Bikes and scooters help with short trips, especially near work and home. Train and metro stations now have bike parking, so people can change transport easily. The city also improves bus travel. Baku has new electric buses to help people who don’t have cars. City leaders say buses are important for the future. These changes show how transport can help people live better in cities. Difficult words: transport (ways to travel), shared (used by more than one person), traffic (cars and other vehicles on the road). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Baku in Azerbaijan changes how people move in the city. Many streets help people walk, ride bikes, and use buses. The city builds bike lanes and bus lanes. Fewer cars use these streets. Many people ride bikes or scooters every day. They save time and money. Train and metro places have bike parking. It helps people change how they travel. Baku also adds electric buses. These buses help people without cars. The city wants clean air and easy travel for everyone. Difficult words: bike lane (a part of the road for bikes only), scooter (a small vehicle, often electric, for one person), add (to put more of something in one place). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The development of video calling started in the late 19 th century; however, the technology became available to the public in the 1930s. These early demonstrations were installed in post offices and they were shown at various world expositions. Attempts to use normal telephony networks to transmit video failed mostly due to poor picture quality and the lack of video compression techniques. The 1955 invention of Television-Phone was hailed ’the telephone of tomorrow’ when it was unveiled by San Diego’s Kay Lab. The device gave a 25-centimeter view of the person who somebody was calling, and it lasted until one of the persons hang up. Very expensive systems continued to evolve throughout the 1980s and 1990s; however, only in the late 20 th century, with high-speed Internet broadband , video calling became a practical technology for regular use. Video calling has become an important part of life since, especially for people working from home during 2020 and 2021, and there have been many mishaps and funny moments, too, while using the technology. Difficult words: compression (the reduction in volume or picture quality so something can be sent faster), broadband (a technique that allows a large number of messages to be communicated at the same time), mishap (an unlucky incident). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In the late 1890s, people started to think that it could be possible to see the person who they were calling. It was not easy to develop such technology . In the 1930s, special boots were in post offices, but the video was very bad. In 1955, the US company Kay Lab invented Television-Phone, and they called it ‘the telephone of tomorrow’. The screen was 25 centimeters wide, and two people could see each other while calling. Scientists developed much better technologies in the 1980s and 1990s, but they were very expensive. In the late 1990s, it became possible to use the Internet for video calling, and people started to use the technology normally. Many people started to use video calling in 2020 because they could not meet each other. Funny moments happened sometimes because people could not use the technology well. Difficult words: develop (to start something and make it better or bigger), technology (systems and ways of doing something), boot (a special place where people made calls from in the past). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Video calling is a technology when you call somebody. You see him at the same time. It is a normal thing for us today. People do not know it one hundred years ago. People first get the idea of video calling in the late 1890s. They do not know how to do it. The first success is in the 1930s. But the video is very bad. A US company makes a Television-Phone in 1955. People see each other when they call. The screen is 25 centimeters wide. The Internet changes video calling in the late 1990s. It is fast and the picture is good. Many people use video calling every day. They work from home or they must stay at home. They are happy that they can see their family and friends on the screen. Difficult words: technology (how people do something and what they use it for), success (when you do something and the result is very good), screen (a flat part of a TV, PC, or phone which people watch). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The US Department of Justice has begun to publish many files about Jeffrey Epstein after Congress passed a law that required this action. The files appear on an official government website called the Epstein Library. The department says it tried to remove private details to protect victims and sensitive material. Because the number of files is very large, officials warn that errors may exist and ask people to report them. Journalists say it will take time to understand what the files truly show. The documents include court papers, records from investigations, interviews, public tips, and items taken by police. Some parts remain hidden because they could name victims, show sexual abuse , or affect ongoing cases. Many survivors say the release causes worry and doesn’t give clear answers. The case has strong political effects. President Trump promised to release the files; however, critics say the process feels slow and unclear. Politicians from both parties now ask for more openness, and public trust remains a key issue. Difficult words: error (a mistake), sexual abuse (when someone is forced into sexual actions), survivor (a person who lived through harm). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The US Department of Justice puts Epstein files online after Congress orders their release . The website says officials hide private details to keep victims safe and protect active cases. Reporters and lawyers now read the files, but they say this will take time because there are so many pages. The files show court papers, interviews, photos, and notes from police work. Many survivors say the release makes them feel worried, and they want clear information. The case causes political problems. President Trump wanted the release, but many people say the government moves too slowly. Both officials and people ask for clearer answers and more open communication about information in the files. Difficult words: release (to make something public or let it go), private (not for others to see), victim (a person who is hurt). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The US officials put Epstein files on a website. A new law says that all people can see them. Officials take out private information. It is important to keep victims safe. Many people say that the files are many and hard to understand. The files show court papers, photos, and talks with people. Many people who have problems with Epstein feel scared. They want clear information. Officials do not answer their questions. The story makes people in politics angry. President Trump says that it is okay to show the files to people. But many people wait to know more than officials tell them. Difficult words: law (official rules of a country), private (not for others to see), victim (a person who is hurt). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A Russian police car helped a family of ducks cross a busy street in Moscow. Passersby also assisted in stopping the traffic and guiding the couple and their 12 ducklings to safety. All drivers waited patiently for the ducks to waddle across the street. The ducks made it to the other side of the road and then to their destination, a nearby park. Wildlife such as ducks and swans live in ponds and lakes, and they usually rely on feeding by the public. Currently, they are being left to go hungry because of the coronavirus lockdown, and some of them are at risk of starvation . Difficult words: passerby (a person who is walking past something, waddle (to walk with short steps and move the body from side to side), starvation (when someone has no food for a long time). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A police car stopped traffic on a busy street in Moscow, Russia. A family of ducks wanted to cross the street, and the police helped them. People who were walking past assisted the police. They guided the couple and their 12 ducklings to the other side of the road. The ducks walked safely to a nearby park. Wildlife such as ducks and swans live in ponds and lakes of big cities. People often feed them, and due to this, many ducks and swans cannot find any food themselves. They need people to get food; however, many people must stay at home now. Ducks and swans are starving , and some of them could die. Difficult words: assist (to help), starve (to be hungry for a long time), need (to depend on someone to do something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Police stop cars on a busy road in Moscow, Russia. The police want to help ducks. The ducks try to cross the road. There are two ducks and 12 ducklings . Other people help the police. They guide the ducks across the road. Drivers must wait. The ducks get to the other side of the road. They walk to a park. Ducks and swans live in ponds and lakes. People like to feed the ducks with bread. However, bread is not good for ducks. Ducks and swans want food from people. Due to this, ducks and swans cannot find food themselves. It is a problem. Many people must stay at home because of the coronavirus. Ducks and swans are very hungry. Difficult words: duckling (a baby duck), guide (to help somebody find the right way), swan (a large white bird with a long neck). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

AI toys become more common before the holiday season as toy stores offer more talking and learning toys each year. These toys promise friendship, fun, and help for children by listening and responding to them. Some products act more like companions than toys and aim to give comfort instead of action or movement. Companies present them as helpful for children’s emotions and development. However, child safety groups raise strong concerns about these AI toys. They warn that rules and research don’t yet protect children enough. Many toys collect personal data, and children often share private thoughts with them. Kids may also take these toys into private places, which increases risk. Past cases show that AI toys can give harmful advice if control systems fail. Despite these worries, big toy companies continue to invest in AI. Some work with large tech firms to create new products. Even so, experts believe traditional toy characters still matter most to children. Familiar movie toys remain popular, especially with new films coming soon. Difficult words: companion (a friend that stays with you), comfort (a good feeling that makes you feel safe and calm), concern (a worry about something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

More AI toys appear in shops before the holiday season. These toys talk, listen, and answer to children. Companies say the toys are fun, help, and can make children happy. Some toys act like friends and react to touch and voice instead of movement. They target older children and focus on feelings, not games. Some experts warn families about AI toys. They say there are not enough rules or studies about them. Many toys get information, and children often share secrets with them. Kids also take these toys to different places at home. In the past, one AI toy said bad things to children, which made some people worry. Still, large toy companies work on new AI toys with tech partners. At the same time, usual toys and movie characters stay popular. Many children prefer familiar characters, especially when new movies bring them back again. The exact history of the wedding ring isn’t absolutely clear; however, one belief dates it to ancient Egypt. Egyptian pharaohs believed that a ring symbolized eternity due to its circular shape with no beginning and no end. Egyptians also believed in ‘veni amoris’, the vein of love. It is the vein in the fourth finger on the left hand that directly connects to the heart; people still commonly wear a wedding ring on that finger. When Alexander the Great conquered Egypt, Greeks adopted the tradition of giving a ring to show devotion, and the tradition carried on when the Romans conquered the Greeks. According to some experts, the Romans viewed the ring as a symbol of a husband’s ownership over his wife, contrary to a sign of love. Later, rings became popular in the West, especially during World War II. Men were going off to fight, and they gave rings to their girlfriends as a promise to wed when they returned. In the 1950s, diamond company De Beers popularized the diamond ring for weddings and engagements. According to a survey, 86% of engagement rings in the US today include a diamond center stone, and an average wedding ring costs 6,000 dollars. Difficult words: eternity (time that never ends), devotion (loyalty and love for someone or something), wed (to marry someone). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The beginning is not clear for the tradition of wedding rings, but some experts believe that it started in ancient Egypt. It is the vein in the fourth finger on the left hand, and it explains why people wear a wedding ring on this finger. Later, this tradition came to Greece and then Rome, where they believed that the ring showed that a man owned his wife. During World War II, men gave rings to women as a promise that they would marry them when they returned home. Diamond rings became popular in the 1950s; company De Beers said in its slogan that diamonds lasted forever. Today, 86% of engagement rings in the US are diamond rings. Difficult words: eternity (time which doesn’t end), vein (a tube through which the body’s blood goes), slogan (a short phrase or sentence which people can easily remember). Difficult words: tradition (something that many people do for a long time), vein (a body part where blood moves in the body), slogan (some words or a sentence which people easily remember). Home Alone is a movie about a boy left alone at Christmas. His family is away on holiday, and two burglars try to break into his house. The boy prepares smart traps to stop them and keep his home safe. The story mixes family moments, danger, and comedy, which makes the movie popular with children and adults. Many famous scenes and lines come from small accidents or quick ideas during filming. Several parts of the movie required special work. The house scenes took place in a school gym, not in a real home. The crew used fake snow made from food to create winter scenes. A stunt double performed many dangerous actions instead of the child actor. Some actors even changed their behavior on set to make reactions look more real. The movie almost failed before release, but it became the most successful film of its year. Today, it remains a strong Christmas tradition and a favorite holiday story around the world. Difficult words: trap (an object to catch someone), stunt (a dangerous action in a movie), double (a person who acts instead of the main actor). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Thailand’s leader has the king’s approval to end the work of parliament and start new national elections in 45 to 60 days. This comes while there are violent fights at the border with Cambodia. The decision surprises many because parliament was in the middle of strong talks about rules, and the main opposition party wanted to test confidence in the government. The leader acted before the opposition could take steps against him. The opposition said the government broke promises, and both sides argued for weeks. The countdown to the next election has begun, and the vote must happen within two months, most likely on a Sunday. The leader may stay in office for a short time before elections. During this time, the government faced problems such as floods that killed people and slow help for victims. The border fights with Cambodia continue, and world leaders are watching. Some people think the leader may use feelings of pride in the country to get more support in the elections. The next weeks will be very important for Thailand’s politics. Difficult words: approval (official agreement or permission to do something), confidence (trust or belief that someone can do something or that something is correct), countdown (counting the time before an event happens). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A 38-year-old man in Italy was a wanted person for assaulting a police officer and trying to avoid prison. He tried to hide by being part of a town’s Christmas nativity scene . The town’s mayor noticed him while passing the display and first thought he was a figure in the scene. Then he realised it was a real person. The mayor called another official to ask the man to leave; however, the man said the Christmas scene was his home. Local police and state workers came and identified the man as a fugitive . He had a prison sentence of nine months and 15 days for not listening to a police officer and for a violent attack. The mayor thanked the police and said this showed it was very important to trust the people who keep everyone safe and follow the law. The town of Galatone, where this happened, has about 15,400 people and is 26 kilometres from Lecce. Difficult words: assault (to hurt or attack someone physically), nativity scene (a display that shows the birth of Jesus, usually with figures of Mary, Joseph, baby Jesus, animals, and sometimes people acting as statues), fugitive (a person who is running away to avoid being caught by the police). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Hollywood faces big change because of new ways people watch movies and shows. TV, streaming, and AI make people spend their time differently. Studios need strong stories and big experiences to bring people to theaters. One of the biggest studios, Warner Bros., is for sale. Experts say the sale can change how the movie business works because fewer companies may control more movies and shows. The main buyers are Netflix and Paramount. Netflix offers to buy the studio, library, and streaming service. Paramount offers to buy the whole company, including cable channels. Each deal has different risks and benefits. Regulators check these sales to see if they give one company too much power. Politics can also influence decisions. Even with big changes, experts say stories remain important. People want experiences with friends at theaters for big movies. Smaller movies may stay at home. The future of Hollywood depends on strong stories, smart business decisions, and the interest of viewers. Difficult words: studio (a place for making movies), regulator (a person or group who controls rules). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Germany looks for doctors from other countries, mostly Latin America, to help with jobs in hospitals and clinics. The program gives help with places to live, visas, and guidance , but the rules to become a certified doctor are difficult. Doctors must learn the German language and pass exams while working under experienced doctors. Dr. Freddy Bautista Vanegas from Bolivia is part of this program and feels welcome in Germany. Patients are happy to meet him and talk about his home country. The program also helps countries like Mexico and Colombia, where there are more medical students than training places. Germany needs more doctors because many jobs in healthcare remain empty. Each German state has different rules, so guidance is important to manage the process. Doctors must get their official qualification within two years. Despite challenges, doctors receive support for housing, language learning, and passing tests. Bautista Vanagas continues preparing for his last medical language exam. Difficult words: guidance (help or advice), certified (allowed or approved officially to do a job), qualification (official proof of skill). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Lionel Messi’s visit to India has created huge excitement among football fans across the country. The Argentine superstar will travel to Kolkata, Hyderabad, Mumbai, and New Delhi for fan events, football games, and promotion . Fans are excited to see him in person after more than a decade since his last visit. Messi will also meet celebrities, young players, and even the Indian Prime Minister during the short 72-hour tour. Messi’s schedule is busy. In Kolkata, he will attend a statue unveiling and meet famous personalities. In Hyderabad, he will play a football match with local leaders. In Mumbai, an exhibition game with Bollywood stars is planned. In New Delhi, Messi will host a football clinic for young players and play another exhibition match, possibly with famous cricketers. His teammates, including Luis Suarez and Rodrigo De Paul, will also join the tour. This tour puts India on the global football map, and it gives fans a rare chance to see one of the world’s greatest players up close. Messi’s visit will bring worldwide media coverage , celebrate Indian football, and inspire fans to connect more with the sport. Difficult words: promotion (an event or activity to show or advertise someone or something), un veil (to show something to people for the first time), media coverage (news and reports about an event in newspapers, TV, or online).
